journey.name: add widgets flow
journey.description: Precondition: onboarded dev wallet, widgets enabled, widgets intro already seen.

actions.action: Verify the wallet overview widgets section is visible
Scroll the widgets page down until "Add Widget" (id "WidgetsAdd") is visible — it sits below the saved widgets and the suggestion cards
Verify the "Add Widget" sheet is visible
If "Bitcoin Calculator" is not visible, scroll the sheet down until it is
Verify the sheet navigates to "Bitcoin Calculator" and "Save Widget" (id "WidgetSave") is visible
